mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with 3 consecutive months of FEDFUNDS decline, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 5.5% for two consecutive months, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 2% in the past month indicates sharp consumer demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST decline > 2% and RSAFS decline > 2% in past month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of interaction-triggered instances, or interaction term Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During a supply shock regime defined by a 10% or greater decline in industrial production (INDPRO) over two consecutive months, corporate output contraction reduces earnings expectations, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or regime-specific Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates weakening labor market conditions that reduce consumer income and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with 3 consecutive months of PAYEMS decline, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.5%, it signals accelerating inflation that prompts Federal Reserve tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in retail sales (RSAFS) and industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1.5% in the past month indicates broad economic slowdown, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS decline > 1.5% and INDPRO decline > 1.5% in past month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of interaction-triggered instances, or interaction term Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market bust regime defined by a 10% or greater decline in housing starts (HOUST) over two consecutive months, consumer wealth contraction reduces spending and equity valuations, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or regime-specific Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
